articles.description:
A lot of times when I talk about higher level abstractions like projects, claude tag and dynamic workflows, I hear concerns about token cost.

With Sonnet + Opus 5.5 I think this sort intelligence is should be very available.

Try Sonnet 5.5 in particular when making workflows.

quoted_tweet.text:
Introducing Claude Sonnet 5.5, the second model in the Claude 5.5 family.

It’s a clear upgrade over Sonnet 5, runs more than 30% faster, and costs up to 30% less for most work. https://t.co/UvXD8mDTF1

articles.summary: Thariq认为，Sonnet与Opus 5.5有望让项目和动态工作流等高阶抽象更容易负担，并特别建议尝试Sonnet 5.5。引用的官方介绍称该模型较Sonnet 5快逾30%，多数工作成本最多低30%。

A fall foliage simulator by @_re_pete, made with Sonnet 5 vs Sonnet 5.5. https://t.co/bVbUmS7tSw
articles.summary: Sonnet 5.5相较Sonnet 5在速度和多数任务成本上有所改善，早期实验展示了用它制作交互式秋叶模拟器。Claude Code指南介绍如何在Sonnet与Opus之间选择、从Sonnet 5迁移并调整effort参数；Thariq认为成本下降也有助于在更高阶的Claude工作流中使用Sonnet。现有演示缓存未包含量化对比结果，开发者仍应在代表性任务上验证质量、延迟和费用。
